_comment: Example AWS EC2 instance registry for pgedge-pep-test regression runs. Copy this file to configuration/aws_instances.json (gitignored) and fill in your own instances before running with --target aws.
_usage: Set 'enabled: true' to include an instance in AWS test runs.
_key_security: Never commit .pem key files. Prefer SSH agent (ssh-add) or AWS_SSH_KEY_PATH env var. If using a file, store it in keys/ (gitignored).
_key_resolution: key_file resolution order: explicit path in this file → AWS_SSH_KEY_PATH env var → SSH agent (ssh-add).
